technique_name: Explain the use of conditionals in programming
description: Conditionals are an integral part of programming, as they allow for a program to execute different instructions depending on the input or values defined by the user. They allow for more complex logic and greater flexibility of the code, allowing for decision-making within the program. Conditionals are statements that test whether an expression is true or false, and execute the code based on this outcome.
